title: ShortLa
tagline: Shorten a long link or note! Simple and fast URL and NOTE shortener!
description:
This project is blockchain based and helps to shorten your links and notes by talking to the contract.

If you want to shorten any link or note, just use this application.

Not at the moment, but there will be user profiles in the future. Users will be able to sell their content from these profiles through a contract.
how_its_made:
I pull all the data about this project through the contract I wrote with Solidity. First of all, I wrote the contract with solidity. Afterwards, I used Node.js to communicate with the contract. The short link algorithm is embedded in the contract.

On the frontend side, I used Vue.js. I used socket.io to integrate with the backend.
